speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned waking up frightened during sleep; can you describe exactly what you see, hear, or feel when these episodes happen?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Since you're tired the next day, have you noticed any specific dreams, sounds, or events happening right before you wake up frightened? Also, have you had any recent nightmares or seen anyone in your sleep?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Difficulty sleeping with episodes of waking up frightened. I also have Yelling and crying during sleep episodes, Temporary post-episode tiredness, Recollection of bad dreams, Bedtime procrastination.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Nightmare Disorder

You have mentioned recollection of bad dreams and bedtime procrastination; could you describe the content of these dreams to help confirm the diagnosis?
